name: coil-spring
prompt: Make a coil spring: a wire 0.03 m thick wound in 6 turns with a coil radius of 0.25 m, each turn rising 0.1 m, so it is about 0.6 m tall.

name: tapering-horn
prompt: Make a curved horn: a round tube starting 0.2 m across at the base that curves up and to the side over about 1 m and tapers to a thin tip, a tenth of the base size.

name: rounded-pipe-run
prompt: Make a pipe run: a round pipe 0.05 m across that goes 1 m along X, then 1 m up, then 1 m along Z, with the two bends rounded smoothly (not sharp corners).
